title: What is no-code? Describe it, get it built | 50agents
description: No-code means building working software without writing code. How it moved from drag-and-drop canvases to describing what you want, with an example.
definition: No-code means building working software without writing programming code, by choosing, arranging or describing what you want.
Early no-code tools meant drag-and-drop canvases; newer ones, 50agents among them, let you describe the result in a sentence and answer a few questions.

example.ask: Track my leads and follow up
example.why: Six words build a leads app: a pipeline, a follow-up list and a crew of AI agents. The AI writes no code; the app is built from parts that are already tested.

build.name: Leads desk
build.line: your pipeline, who to follow up today
build.when: Every weekday at 9:00, and 3 quiet days after contact
does: Adds new leads from your Gmail
